title: Operations Director

identified_pain: Owner is frequently on job sites in the field, leading to unanswered calls going to voicemail during peak afternoon hours.

title: Customer Care Manager

notes: Double pitch opportunity: Speed-to-lead missed call + Past customer reactivation sprint.

title: Managing Partner

notes: Massive ticket size. 1 saved roof inspection = 10x ROI on our $500 fee.

title: Owner & Master Plumber

notes: High urgency niche. 5-second SMS auto-response saves 90% of lost callers.
